beats.text: Same model, same seventeen questions, three **frameworks**: my own loop, Deep Agents, and Google **ADK**.
On the needle in the big table, my loop needed about twenty-eight hundred tokens per right answer.
ADK with my tools, five **thousand**. ADK with its own tools, eight thousand.
Out of seventeen, Deep Agents scored six, or ten with a sub-agent. ADK scored nine, or eight.
ADK with its own tools, **twelve**. My loop, twelve, with its best set-up for each task.
Most failures were not wrong answers. They were runs that **never** answered. Deep Agents hit the forty-call cap on eighteen of thirty-four runs.
In one run it had the answer after the first search, and then **re-read** the same line again and again.
A guard that stops repeated calls saved tokens, but it did not fix the **loop**.
And ADK's own shell runs with your environment variables. I ran it inside a Docker box with no **network**.
So set a **cap**, read the loops, and box the shell. This was one local model, not **Gemini**.
